name: antigravity
description: Ask Google's Antigravity CLI (agy) for a second opinion or a review of the branch's changes from another model family, read-only, or an image, and save the result locally.

foregroundMinutes.title: Foreground wait (minutes)
foregroundMinutes.description: How long a request waits for agy before it keeps going as a background job.

backgroundMinutes.title: Background job limit (minutes)
backgroundMinutes.description: How long a request may run in all before it is stopped; agy's own --print-timeout is set to it.

agyPath.title: agy CLI path
agyPath.description: Absolute path of the agy executable; leave empty to look on PATH, then in ~/.local/bin, /opt/homebrew/bin and /usr/local/bin.

defaultModel.title: Default model
defaultModel.description: agy model id a request uses when it names none (see /agy-doctor or agy models); leave empty for agy's own default.
